The structure of Na6Ho6Cu4S8 (Na3Ho3Cu2S4) is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119), containing 24 atoms per unit cell across 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ho in tetrahedral S coordination (4 neighbors, 2.45–2.50 Å) and Cu in tetrahedral S coordination (4 neighbors, 2.22–2.34 Å), while Na adopts octahedral S coordination (6 neighbors, 2.58–2.94 Å). The same analysis finds corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Na octahedra, edge-sharing between Na octahedra, and corner-sharing between Ho and Cu tetrahedra, with the geometric neighbor graph forming a single 3-periodic component.
